title: Migration Center and People Downstairs
content: I was told a secret in a dream by a woman, who was accompanying another woman when they came to see me in a small dark room I was being contained in, about 10x10 sq. ft.. I was lying down on a cot holding my 3 year old son and my aunt was there with me. I remember I was pretending to be sleep, and didn't want my aunt to know I was awake. In real life, she is a mental health doctor....idk if that means anything. But she was on the phone in the dream, and I don't remember what she was talking about, but it was something about me and I was very shocked at what she was talking about. I couldn't believe my aunt could do whatever it was that she did to me. I pretended to snore because I knew there was no way in hell she could find out that I was still awake after what I had just heard (whatever it was that I heard her say). Then, I heard my son crying from a distance (he was 3 years old at the time I had this dream). I don't know how I heard him crying from afar off when in my dream, I was holding him. I remember asking myself how could I have two of the same babies. I was holding him, but I heard him crying from a distance. It was really weird, but anyway, I knew I had to go get him so I forced myself to fall asleep while I was pretending to be sleep in the dream. I also knew that he was "upstairs". My aunt ended up leaving or disappearing from out of the small dark room we were in, and I knew she'd be back and that it would be my only opportunity to go get my son. So, I run up some stairs after running down a hall and making some turns, and I go get my son. Crazy part is, when I got to him, it was the same room I had just left, but it was at a higher level in this place I was in. All I knew was that I had to get back downstairs quick. As I was running down the stairwell holding my son, there was this crazed man who was trying to stop me and he grabbed my son's crotch. I yelled at him but knew I had to keep going and couldn't be distracted. I made it back downstairs with my son. I remember wondering where the "son" was that I was holding before I had left out of the room. I laid back down on the cot with my son, then a couple of women walked in the room. One of the women was pretending to be there for something else, but came up to me discreetly when the other woman she was with was not looking and I could just perceive that she was there to help me escape. She asked me something about some hairspray, and I also perceived that she was just making small talk or something so that the other woman she was with wouldn't catch on to what she really wanted to talk to me about. She ended up telling me where I was and told me to not tell anyone what she was about to say or things could get very bad. She was very serious and I could tell she was risking a lot by telling me what she was about to tell me. At that moment, I realized that I was dreaming, and I asked her where I was and why was I there. She looked at me as though she was shocked that I didn't know where I was, like "yeah right, you know where you are". But I did not know... She again started talking about hairspray, and asked me do I remember telling her that she could come and get it from me. I had no idea what she was talking about, and again, I assumed she was just saying that so the other woman would not be alarmed at us talking. It was like she wasn't supposed to be talking to me. She started describing the place where we were when we had the conversation about the hairspray. She then told me her name like I was supposed to remember it, but I forgot what it was. She ended up telling me the name of this place where we had this conversation about this hairspray, and it was either called "Essex", but it may have been "Epic". Anyway, she said it was right beside the Migration Center. I said WHAT THE HELL IS A MIGRATION CENTER very loudly. She explained to me that the Migration Center was where people transferred up and down. I said wym up and down? Then she started talking about Jesus and how the people "upstairs" don't know anything about the real Jesus but they think they do. She also said something about how they are the only ones who really know him when they travel upstairs and was talking about how she/they (people downstairs) couldn't understand why it was so hard for us to know who Jesus really is. It was a lot more she was saying but I can't remember, but I remember feeling very enlightened and how everything she was telling me made so much sense, as though something had been unlocked in my mind. I knew that I was not supposed to know these things she was telling me. Anyway, she gave me directions on how to leave "downstairs" and that I needed to first go and blend in with the people "outside" first. So, I left out of the room and ended up in this outdoor space that looked like a fake garden, because it was so perfect-like. It was sunny outside, perfect weather and lots of plants and flowers and vegetation growing all around this picnic-like area. I sat at a table with some people and began talking to a woman about what, idk. I really don't know what happened after that, but somehow, I was transported in some futuristic looking vehicle and got out alone. I saw a door, opened the door, and it looked like I was in the clouds, but I was standing on this very shiny surface and it was so bright, like everything was just made of light. I stood there and waited, then I woke up. Has anyone ever had a dream about a Migration Center or anything about some people upstair/downstairs?
